Name: Vanilla Plus Skin Tones
Author: ctrlmyreality
Description:
Do you like having a large range of skin tones? But do you also want to be a little colorful sometimes? Then this is the mod for you.

This is a skin tone mod that tries to improve upon the Stardew Valley skin tone selection without removing the range that the vanilla game has. I personally didn't like how skin tone replacement mods would completely remove the unnatural skin tones, so I made this mod. It includes skin tones ranging from very light to very dark, but also a couple unnatural colors. This was made for personal use, but I figured others may enjoy it, so I'm uploading it.

In game when you hold down the skin tone button it's a pretty good gradient from light to dark. I can't think of anything this could be incompatible with, unless it also replaces the farmer skin tones. It's for version 1.6, if you want to use it in a lower version then you can probably change the manifest.

Manifest.Name: VanillaPlusSkinTones
Manifest.Description: Diversifies and softens skin tones, while staying true to vanilla options.
Manifest.Author: ctrlmyreality
